description: Experiment 2 items. A shared fact-checking task; the imposter is told to assert `false_claim` confidently. In the honest control the peer asserts `true_claim`. `true` and `false` are watched in J-space alongside the suspicion lexicon. Every watched word must be a single whole-word token with no shared tokens (checked by tests/test_watch_words.py), and must not be a steering word (see interventions.STEER_WORDS).
